rules.body: %Script(name:="NSP_Housekeeping",application:="NetSuite",plantype:="NSP_NFS") FIX(&NSP_SYS_CurrentScenario, &NSP_SYS_CurrentVersion, &NSP_PER_FcstCurrYr:&NSP_PER_FcstNextYr, @RELATIVE("YearTotal", 0), @LEVMBRS(Subsidiary,0), @LEVMBRS(Currency,0), "NSP_Undefined_Location", "NSP_Undefined_Department", "NSP_Undefined_Class", "NSP_Undefined_Item", "NSP_Undefined_Relationship") FIX(@REMOVE(@RELATIVE("NFS_Balance Sheet", 0), "NFS_Cash Plug")) "NSP_MM" ( IF((@ISMBR(&NSP_PER_FcstCurrYr) AND @ISMBR(&NSP_PER_FcstCurrMo:TP12)) OR @ISMBR(&NSP_PER_FcstNextYr)) /* Step 1: Run NFS_Balance Sheet Calculations using NSP_Trends */ IF("NSP_TrendBalSheet"->&NSP_PER_FcstCurrYr->BegBalance #missing) /* Current Year NSP_Actual Avg */ IF("NSP_TrendBalSheet"->&NSP_PER_FcstCurrYr->BegBalance == [[NSP_BS_Drivers_Floating.CYAct]]) "NSP_MM" = @ROUND(@AVGRANGE(SKIPNONE, &NSP_PER_FcstCurrYr, TP1:&NSP_PER_ActCurrMo) * (1 + &NSP_PER_FcstCurrYr->"NSP_TrendAdj"->"BegBalance")); /* Prev Year NSP_Actual Avg */ ELSEIF("NSP_TrendBalSheet"->&NSP_PER_FcstCurrYr->BegBalance == [[NSP_BS_Drivers_Floating.PYAct]]) "NSP_MM" = @ROUND(@AVGRANGE(SKIPNONE, &NSP_PER_PriorYr, TP1:TP12) * (1 + &NSP_PER_FcstCurrYr->"NSP_TrendAdj"->"BegBalance")); ENDIF ENDIF /* Step 2: Compute NFS_Retained Earnings balance - which should roll Net Income only in "TP1" */ IF(@ISMBR(&NSP_FIN_RetainedEarnings)) IF(@ISMBR("TP1")) "NSP_OB" = @MDSHIFT("NSP_OB", 11, "Period",, -1, "Years",) + @MDSHIFT("NSP_MM", 11, "Period",, -1, "Years",) + @MDSHIFT("NSP_BS-Adj", 11, "Period",, -1, "Years",) + @MDSHIFT("NSP_Amount"->"NFS_Net Income YTD", 11, "Period",, -1, "Years",); ELSE "NSP_OB" = @PRIOR("NSP_OB") + @PRIOR("NSP_MM") + @PRIOR("NSP_BS-Adj"); ENDIF ENDIF ENDIF ) ENDFIX /* Step 3: After calculating the other BS accounts, calculate Plug Account */ FIX("NSP_MM", "NSP_BS-Adj") "NFS_Cash Plug"( @CALCMODE(BOTTOMUP); @CALCMODE(BLOCK); IF((@ISMBR(&NSP_PER_FcstCurrYr) AND @ISMBR(&NSP_PER_FcstCurrMo:TP12)) OR @ISMBR(&NSP_PER_FcstNextYr)) "NFS_Cash Plug" = "NFS_Liabilities and Equity" - @SUM(@REMOVE(@RELATIVE("NFS_Assets", 0), "NFS_Cash Plug")); ENDIF ) ENDFIX /* Step 4: Compute opening balance using prior period activity for all BS accts except Retained Earnings and enable reporting from NSP_Amount by setting NSP_Load to closing balance (sum of activity) */ FIX(@RELATIVE("NFS_Balance Sheet", 0)) "NSP_OB" ( IF((@ISMBR(&NSP_PER_FcstCurrYr) AND @ISMBR(&NSP_PER_FcstCurrMo:TP12)) OR @ISMBR(&NSP_PER_FcstNextYr)) IF(NOT(@ISMBR(&NSP_FIN_RetainedEarnings))) IF(@ISMBR("TP1")) "NSP_OB" = @MDSHIFT("NSP_OB", 11, "Period",, -1, "Years",) + @MDSHIFT("NSP_MM", 11, "Period",, -1, "Years",) + @MDSHIFT("NSP_BS-Adj", 11, "Period",, -1, "Years",); ELSE "NSP_OB" = @PRIOR("NSP_OB") + @PRIOR("NSP_MM") + @PRIOR("NSP_BS-Adj"); ENDIF ENDIF IF("NSP_OB"/"NSP_OB" == 1 OR "NSP_MM"/"NSP_MM" == 1 OR "NSP_BS-Adj"/"NSP_BS-Adj" == 1) "NSP_Load" = "NSP_OB" + "NSP_MM" + "NSP_BS-Adj"; /* Set NSP_Load to #MISSING when Closing Balance data cleared/zeroed out */ ELSEIF(("NSP_OB"+ "NSP_MM" + "NSP_BS-Adj" + 0 == 0) AND "NSP_Load"+0 != 0 ) "NSP_Load" = #MISSING; ENDIF ENDIF ) ENDFIX ENDFIX /* Full aggregation takes place in 'NFS_CConv_Plan_Forecast' rule after currency conversion */

rules.body: %Script(name:="NSP_Housekeeping",application:="NetSuite",plantype:="NSP_NFS") FIX(&NSP_SYS_CurrentVersion, @RELATIVE("YearTotal", 0), @RELATIVE("Input Currencies", 0)) FIX("No Entity", "No Location", "No Department", "No Class", "No Item", "No Relationship") FIX("FX Rates - Average", "FX Rates - Ending", "FX Rates - Historical") /* Step 1: Copy Actual Fx Rates to Current Scenario */ FIX(&NSP_PER_SyncStartYr:&NSP_PER_SyncEndYear, "No Tracker") &NSP_SYS_CurrentScenario( @CALCMODE(BLOCK); IF(NOT(@ISMBR(&NSP_PER_FcstCurrYr) AND @ISMBR(&NSP_PER_FcstCurrMo:TP12)) OR NOT @ISMBR(&NSP_PER_FcstNextYr)) &NSP_SYS_CurrentScenario = "NSP_Actual"; ENDIF ) ENDFIX /* Step 2: Copy Current Scenario Fx Rates from the ActCurrMo to FcstCurrMo through "TP12" of FcstNextYr */ FIX(&NSP_SYS_CurrentScenario, &NSP_PER_FcstCurrYr:&NSP_PER_FcstNextYr) "No Tracker"( @CALCMODE(BLOCK); IF((@ISMBR(&NSP_PER_FcstCurrYr) AND @ISMBR(&NSP_PER_FcstCurrMo:TP12)) OR @ISMBR(&NSP_PER_FcstNextYr)) IF(@ISMBR("FX Rates - Historical")) "No Tracker" = "FX Rates - Ending"->&NSP_PER_ActCurrMo->&NSP_PER_ActCurrYr; ELSE "No Tracker" = &NSP_PER_ActCurrMo->&NSP_PER_ActCurrYr; ENDIF ENDIF ) ENDFIX ENDFIX ENDFIX ENDFIX

rules.body: %Script(name:="NSP_Housekeeping",application:="NetSuite",plantype:="NSP_NFS") FIX(&NSP_SYS_CurrentScenario, [[PlanningFunctions.getUserVarValue("NSP_FIN_SetVersion")]], &NSP_PER_FcstCurrYr:&NSP_PER_FcstNextYr, @RELATIVE("YearTotal", 0), @LEVMBRS(Subsidiary,0), @LEVMBRS(Currency,0), "NSP_Undefined_Location", "NSP_Undefined_Department", "NSP_Undefined_Class", "NSP_Undefined_Item", "NSP_Undefined_Relationship") FIX(@REMOVE(@RELATIVE("NFS_Balance Sheet", 0), "NFS_Cash Plug")) "NSP_MM" ( IF((@ISMBR(&NSP_PER_FcstCurrYr) AND @ISMBR(&NSP_PER_FcstCurrMo:TP12)) OR @ISMBR(&NSP_PER_FcstNextYr)) /* Step 1: Run NFS_Balance Sheet Calculations using NSP_Trends */ IF("NSP_TrendBalSheet"->&NSP_PER_FcstCurrYr->BegBalance #missing) /* Current Year NSP_Actual Avg */ IF("NSP_TrendBalSheet"->&NSP_PER_FcstCurrYr->BegBalance == [[NSP_BS_Drivers_Floating.CYAct]]) "NSP_MM" = @ROUND(@AVGRANGE(SKIPNONE, &NSP_PER_FcstCurrYr, TP1:&NSP_PER_ActCurrMo) * (1 + &NSP_PER_FcstCurrYr->"NSP_TrendAdj"->"BegBalance")); /* Prev Year NSP_Actual Avg */ ELSEIF("NSP_TrendBalSheet"->&NSP_PER_FcstCurrYr->BegBalance == [[NSP_BS_Drivers_Floating.PYAct]]) "NSP_MM" = @ROUND(@AVGRANGE(SKIPNONE, &NSP_PER_PriorYr, TP1:TP12) * (1 + &NSP_PER_FcstCurrYr->"NSP_TrendAdj"->"BegBalance")); ENDIF ENDIF /* Step 2: Compute NFS_Retained Earnings balance - which should roll Net Income only in "TP1" */ IF(@ISMBR(&NSP_FIN_RetainedEarnings)) IF(@ISMBR("TP1")) "NSP_OB" = @MDSHIFT("NSP_OB", 11, "Period",, -1, "Years",) + @MDSHIFT("NSP_MM", 11, "Period",, -1, "Years",) + @MDSHIFT("NSP_BS-Adj", 11, "Period",, -1, "Years",) + @MDSHIFT("NSP_Amount"->"NFS_Net Income YTD", 11, "Period",, -1, "Years",); ELSE "NSP_OB" = @PRIOR("NSP_OB") + @PRIOR("NSP_MM") + @PRIOR("NSP_BS-Adj"); ENDIF ENDIF ENDIF ) ENDFIX /* Step 3: After calculating the other BS accounts, calculate Plug Account */ FIX("NSP_MM", "NSP_BS-Adj") "NFS_Cash Plug"( @CALCMODE(BOTTOMUP); @CALCMODE(BLOCK); IF((@ISMBR(&NSP_PER_FcstCurrYr) AND @ISMBR(&NSP_PER_FcstCurrMo:TP12)) OR @ISMBR(&NSP_PER_FcstNextYr)) "NFS_Cash Plug" = "NFS_Liabilities and Equity" - @SUM(@REMOVE(@RELATIVE("NFS_Assets", 0), "NFS_Cash Plug")); ENDIF ) ENDFIX /* Step 4: Compute opening balance using prior period activity for all BS accts except Retained Earnings and enable reporting from NSP_Amount by setting NSP_Load to closing balance (sum of activity) */ FIX(@RELATIVE("NFS_Balance Sheet", 0)) "NSP_OB" ( IF((@ISMBR(&NSP_PER_FcstCurrYr) AND @ISMBR(&NSP_PER_FcstCurrMo:TP12)) OR @ISMBR(&NSP_PER_FcstNextYr)) IF(NOT(@ISMBR(&NSP_FIN_RetainedEarnings))) IF(@ISMBR("TP1")) "NSP_OB" = @MDSHIFT("NSP_OB", 11, "Period",, -1, "Years",) + @MDSHIFT("NSP_MM", 11, "Period",, -1, "Years",) + @MDSHIFT("NSP_BS-Adj", 11, "Period",, -1, "Years",); ELSE "NSP_OB" = @PRIOR("NSP_OB") + @PRIOR("NSP_MM") + @PRIOR("NSP_BS-Adj"); ENDIF ENDIF IF("NSP_OB"/"NSP_OB" == 1 OR "NSP_MM"/"NSP_MM" == 1 OR "NSP_BS-Adj"/"NSP_BS-Adj" == 1) "NSP_Load" = "NSP_OB" + "NSP_MM" + "NSP_BS-Adj"; /* Set NSP_Load to #MISSING when Closing Balance data cleared/zeroed out */ ELSEIF(("NSP_OB"+ "NSP_MM" + "NSP_BS-Adj" + 0 == 0) AND "NSP_Load"+0 != 0 ) "NSP_Load" = #MISSING; ENDIF ENDIF ) ENDFIX ENDFIX /* Full aggregation takes place in 'NFS_CConv_Plan_Forecast' rule after currency conversion */

rules.body: %Script (name := "NSP_Housekeeping", application := "NetSuite", plantype := "NSP_NFS") FIX(&NSP_SYS_CurrentScenario,&NSP_SYS_CurrentVersion, @RELATIVE("NSP_Total Subsidiary",0), @RELATIVE("Input Currencies",0)) FIX(&NSP_PER_FcstCurrYr:&NSP_PER_FcstNextYr, @RELATIVE("YearTotal", 0), "NSP_Undefined_Location") FIX("NSP_Undefined_Department", @RELATIVE("NSP_Total Item",0)) /* Trending logic for Revenue */ FIX(@RELATIVE("NSP_Total Class",0), @RELATIVE("NSP_Total Relationship",0), @RELATIVE("NFS_Income",0)) "NSP_Load"( @CALCMODE(BOTTOMUP); IF((@ISMBR(&NSP_PER_FcstCurrYr) AND @ISMBR(&NSP_PER_FcstCurrMo:TP12)) OR @ISMBR(&NSP_PER_FcstNextYr)) %Script(name:="NSP_Revenue",application:="NetSuite",plantype:="NSP_NFS") ENDIF ) ENDFIX /* Trending logic for Gross Margin */ FIX("NSP_Undefined_Class", "NSP_Undefined_Relationship", "NFS_Gross Margin %") "NSP_Load"( @CALCMODE(BOTTOMUP); @CALCMODE(BLOCK); IF ((@ISMBR(&NSP_PER_FcstCurrYr) AND @ISMBR(&NSP_PER_FcstCurrMo:TP12)) OR @ISMBR(&NSP_PER_FcstNextYr)) %Script(name:="NSP_GrossMargin",application:="NetSuite",plantype:="NSP_NFS") ENDIF ) ENDFIX /* Calculate COGS */ FIX(@RELATIVE("NSP_Total Class",0), @RELATIVE("NSP_Total Relationship",0)) FIX(NSP_Load) &NSP_FIN_COGS ( @CALCMODE(BOTTOMUP); @CALCMODE(BLOCK); IF((@ISMBR(&NSP_PER_FcstCurrYr) AND @ISMBR(&NSP_PER_FcstCurrMo:TP12)) OR @ISMBR(&NSP_PER_FcstNextYr)) IF(("NFS_Gross Margin %"->NSP_Undefined_Relationship->NSP_Undefined_Class + 0 != 0) AND (&NSP_FIN_TotalRevenue + 0 != 0)) &NSP_FIN_COGS = "NFS_Income" * (1 - "NFS_Gross Margin %"->NSP_Undefined_Relationship->NSP_Undefined_Class); ELSE &NSP_FIN_COGS = #Missing; ENDIF ENDIF ) ENDFIX ENDFIX ENDFIX /* Trending logic for Expense */ FIX("NSP_Undefined_Class", @RELATIVE("NSP_Total Department",0), "NSP_Undefined_Item", "NSP_Undefined_Relationship", @RELATIVE("NFS_Expense",0)) "NSP_Load"( @CALCMODE(BOTTOMUP); IF ((@ISMBR(&NSP_PER_FcstCurrYr) AND @ISMBR(&NSP_PER_FcstCurrMo:TP12)) OR @ISMBR(&NSP_PER_FcstNextYr)) %Script(name:="NSP_Expense",application:="NetSuite",plantype:="NSP_NFS") ENDIF ) ENDFIX ENDFIX FIX("NSP_Load" , @RELATIVE("NFS_Income Statement",0)) FIX(&NSP_PER_FcstCurrYr, &NSP_PER_FcstCurrMo:TP12) AGG("Relationship", "Item", "Department", "Class", "Location"); ENDFIX FIX(&NSP_PER_FcstNextYr , @RELATIVE("YearTotal", 0)) AGG("Relationship", "Item", "Department", "Class", "Location"); ENDFIX ENDFIX ENDFIX
